assessment: Public sightseeing cable car from central Torreón to Puerto Noas with a separate ticket. Puerto Noas, Christmas village and parking are not the cable car itself.

observations.length: 1466 metres according to municipal tourism; the convention bureau gives 1437 metres, so city value takes precedence
observations.seasonalHours: Daily 11:00–22:00 beginning 26 Nov 2026, announced by director for Christmas village period; validity capped 7 Jan 2027
observations.fare: MXN 30 adult; MXN 15 reduced for seniors, students, disabled visitors
observations.separateProducts: Aldea Navideña entrance free; parking MXN 50 separately at Cristo de las Noas access.
